investorGroup.title: My investment in Southfield Group
investorGroup.sub: Across {{count}} companies · as of {{date}} · analytics, plus requests to Admin
investorGroup.moneyIn: Money in from buyers, by month · last 12 months
investorGroup.noMoney: No receipts posted in the last 12 months.
investorGroup.nwNote: Book net worth from the company's books: equity accounts plus profit to date, before audit, depreciation and tax. Capital accounts count as investment.
investorGroup.how1: Value of my shares = the company's book net worth × my share %.
investorGroup.how2: It is a book value, not a market price.
investorGroup.how3: My investment is my capital account and other recorded investment in each company, shown apart from the value of my shares.
investorGroup.how4: Values come from the books before audit, depreciation and tax; they change when each year's balance sheet is closed.
investorGroup.cantSee: Buyer names, invoices, documents, salaries and bills without GST. Those stay in the company app with Admin.
